dct_title_s: Satellite-detected Damage the UNESCO Tentative List component Chiang Mai as of 29 March 2025
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: EQ20250328THA, GDACS ID: 1474477** This map shows no visible damage based on a very high resolution satellite image collected 29 March 2025 when compared to very high resolution satellite imagery from 1 February 2025. The USGS shake map indicates the intensity of the earthquake measured 5.0 in this area. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
